parent_models.justification: DeepLabv3+ is an extension of the DeepLab family of models, making 'deeplab' the parent model.

closest_parent_model.justification: Since 'deeplab' is the foundational model in the DeepLab series, it serves as the closest and most direct parent model to DeepLabv3+.

closest_child_model.justification: There are no child models explicitly related or extending DeepLabv3+; however, the model itself serves as an extension of deeplab.

closest_sibling_model.justification: No close sibling models relative to deeplab but classified under deep learning mapping.

unrelated_models.justification: Despite being categorized under deep learning, deep4net has no established connection with the deeplab series or segmentation.
